body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Utrecht, Netherlands. It starts at Rijksweg 87.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Have a great day out at the Museum for Old Crafts and Toys! Older generations will get to reminisce about the good old days, while youngsters might recognize objects from visiting their grandparents. There’s no doubt you’ll run into things you used to play with!
>
> Kids will get to have some good old fashioned fun without a smartphone or Playstation, and find out how past generations had fun before electricity, TV and the internet.
>
> The museum also offers plenty of fun scavenger hunts through the past for kids young and old! There’s an indoor activity room for fun and games, and outside you’ll find an area packed with old Dutch games!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.04. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 34 ratings and 32 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
